name: screen
title: Screen
summary: An LCD: dark glass in a well whose type and marks are lit in the accent.
use: For live readouts, levels and status an instrument shows: timecode, render settings, meters over time.
anatomy: Readouts: dim label over a lit value (DSScreenReadout)
rules: A screen stays dark in both themes.
Values are lit in the accent; labels are dim.
Screens show, they never take input beyond their mode tabs.
accessibility: Readouts combine their label and value; bars announce their levels.
